Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 102, "heading": "IX THÉNARDIER À LA MANŒUVRE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u102-r0030", "target": "— Счёт отдашь тому человеку.", "source_sha256": "4c8ba3686236750b91015dcb5695f397c4b8e63512b39434e93c7af742b2f7e8", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u102-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "8f3efe08b628d16a484a8a57ef252fd8ef022626016c1d3c5703c1cc5dd81caa"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u102-r0031", "target": "Затем он вышел.", "source_sha256": "dbe98660fe60537e946f732c5e9ed4d23c942c8dabc18315b71a1065e2263124", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u102-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "8afba4a880a7aec46690551fc6f379e4e636d7b122cf651ae606495d7736aa05"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 2, "book": 3, "chapter": 9, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u102-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il était à peine hors de la salle que le voyageur y entra.", "sha256": "26cfe3ea38de245ae55aad72a95f7bd8911317bb964d259a8f4f130df7117bc8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le Thénardier reparut sur-le-champ derrière lui et demeura immobile dans la porte entre-bâillée, visible seulement pour sa femme.", "sha256": "7f1feee621ca2c0a2fc510db643d973ef50cfe16a7a069ab0f14de41567bdef7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme jaune portait à la main son bâton et son paquet.", "sha256": "8ca5a8e173a49c17c59e1190e2fae862434c8f1f4b317a0f3dbf3066ae06e6a5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Levé si tôt ! dit la Thénardier, est-ce que monsieur nous quitte déjà ?", "sha256": "3728ddbd200985580abb4a6463c0040c321b7cfd858a09c86a3c0202d47c3294", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Tout en parlant ainsi, elle tournait d’un air embarrassé la carte dans ses mains et y faisait des plis avec ses ongles. Son visage dur offrait une nuance qui ne lui était pas habituelle, la timidité et le scrupule.", "sha256": "82649ed210e3dfff210d9ab257b813133e852967aa890f76bd94285a1a69c3f7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "Présenter une pareille note à un homme qui avait si parfaitement l’air d’ « un pauvre », cela lui paraissait malaisé.", "sha256": "76533d62477c11c5eac20eac3b6a9377aeab0bce85158dc306bd785ad8a8cd55", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le voyageur semblait préoccupé et distrait. Il répondit :", "sha256": "4989fd9a97e6444023c4e2108b26ec366c5e801af4edd6c46b8df0c2016afb25", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, madame, je m’en vais.", "sha256": "82a108737841f005edfe9731efd2f7aeca0bd19a8fcd8e922fe6f2b8146fbfbf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Monsieur, reprit-elle, n’avait donc pas d’affaires à Montfermeil ?", "sha256": "096575749ffc6689d14c6406133067f7636654a5518f62ffeb38f06cf3fb05c1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non. Je passe par ici. Voilà tout. — Madame, ajouta-t-il, qu’est-ce que je dois ?", "sha256": "cd93f99c678fb1672aa3dd9be9b9076138bf5c66f86997246117f3a22a3f7c2c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "La Thénardier, sans répondre, lui tendit la carte pliée. L’homme déplia le papier, et le regarda, mais son attention était visiblement ailleurs.", "sha256": "f356acf4868761f546ec592349dd012b51b28c1853001b12f21dd1ae60cb795a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Madame, reprit-il, faites-vous de bonnes affaires dans ce Montfermeil ?", "sha256": "ab4997d295a383c84fbe1372d23038cddcba4a272b157972802686b88df9f2ad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme cela, monsieur, répondit la Thénardier stupéfaite de ne point voir d’autre explosion.", "sha256": "e2d22a536543cdbe41f2206534df0025903be0c3b4f688c1cd269b17961f2bb6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle poursuivit d’un accent élégiaque et lamentable :", "sha256": "0bf203e1b4d49b2f87450f91542b976bb0e8d0cf4740f8b1dc2fa3bae930145d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! monsieur, les temps sont bien durs ! et puis nous avons si peu de bourgeois dans nos endroits ! C’est tout petit monde, voyez-vous. Si nous n’avions pas par-ci par-là des voyageurs généreux et riches comme monsieur ! Nous avons tant de charges. Tenez, cette petite nous coûte les yeux de la tête.", "sha256": "fbf486bccb200c547265e0e158d99259d49348d6f23f067d113aa45a99717018", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelle petite ?", "sha256": "1641d92957e14ba6e43eb6ebb36739a1e4578647edcec5bfaff83faa09368f32", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, la petite, vous savez ! Cosette ! l’Alouette, comme on dit dans le pays !", "sha256": "006b899a25ef79805c8ea9addbcebc57b1c27f07ee153a56dc983a6e3252b7af", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! dit l’homme.", "sha256": "32470c92c97f2baab9c54b6360b1ddd2b503279dec0d0800a12856aa3b9d6815", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "Elle continua :", "sha256": "d15e8f8db7df2049fdc3f693084cae7227e20dfe45e408f92d2693abe4c2e1e1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sont-ils bêtes, ces paysans, avec leurs sobriquets ! elle a plutôt l’air d’une chauve-souris que d’une alouette. Voyez-vous, monsieur, nous ne demandons pas la charité, mais nous ne pouvons pas la faire. Nous ne gagnons rien et nous avons gros à payer. La patente, les impositions, les portes et fenêtres, les centimes ! Monsieur sait que le gouvernement demande un argent terrible. Et puis j’ai mes filles, moi. Je n’ai pas besoin de nourrir l’enfant des autres.", "sha256": "db95ee910f096d7b9c797b4e2459de214623b42e22a7da42905de9798b939e1a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme reprit, de cette voix qu’il s’efforçait de rendre indifférente et dans laquelle il y avait un tremblement :", "sha256": "7cab5132e9d7df9da3472293a30af703ce52050053db9c4240fad9305ee41085", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et si l’on vous en débarrassait ?", "sha256": "6ad458bbba5c1262c65c03dc64ee77d19b3f8910c589d8f3423ddfb4051b41c1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— De qui ? de la Cosette ?", "sha256": "29d0ac247adeaf4ca7726d4e8768a6097b37a600ab01ae181fd33cd7f29ce85b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "La face rouge et violente de la gargotière s’illumina d’un épanouissement hideux.", "sha256": "57812532d350dd1bb426635e7e154c755f324bb63b7bc7d906af7ad147684074", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah, monsieur ! mon bon monsieur ! prenez-la, gardez-la, emmenez-la, emportez-la, sucrez-la, truffez-la, buvez-la, mangez-la, et soyez béni de la bonne sainte Vierge et de tous les saints du paradis !", "sha256": "c5c4f0ee0ee3378893dcf0f1d72e5dde8cf9c511304e8831d280669c5c85ca08", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est dit.", "sha256": "f3b369249b11615ceb373dfa5e68566fd669f334ed72a4fda0f33a7f857cd33f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vrai ? vous l’emmenez ?", "sha256": "74d1509863dcd6530790c12eb6db9ad10ad74941c3040bbe2c504bfe3e723b49", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je l’emmène.", "sha256": "1d73994ec73b821d3aa623a2578008e84c99042a3421b7cb90d5e6c4ffbf1584", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tout de suite ?", "sha256": "a1162624d33b223baba538c3397309fbb4152a8bd27c1583e1e8b67f64cfd8c7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tout de suite. Appelez l’enfant.", "sha256": "a1204a72274969e26ffe3c1f0f6fcc774fa1c1b798c22b7a7665806a52eca42f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u102-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cosette ! cria la Thénardier.", "sha256": "8ce0fbcad6b82095fbad71da2ba13f14192277d4a34c972bd21aeead5ae412e7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
